keyPoints.en: An AP has a constant common difference d = T₂ − T₁ = T₃ − T₂ = …
keyPoints.bm: JA mempunyai beza sepunya malar d = T₂ − T₁ = T₃ − T₂ = …

keyPoints.en: Sum: Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d] or Sₙ = n/2 (a + l) where l is the last term.
keyPoints.bm: Hasil tambah: Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d] atau Sₙ = n/2 (a + l) dengan l sebutan terakhir.

keyPoints.en: Tₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ — useful when you're given a formula for Sₙ.
keyPoints.bm: Tₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ — berguna apabila diberi rumus Sₙ.

keyPoints.en: Three terms in an AP: x − d, x, x + d (so the middle term is the average of the other two).
keyPoints.bm: Tiga sebutan dalam JA: x − d, x, x + d (sebutan tengah ialah purata dua yang lain).

question.en: k, 2k + 1 and 5k − 3 are consecutive terms of an AP. Find k.
question.bm: k, 2k + 1 dan 5k − 3 ialah sebutan berturutan JA. Cari k.

tip.en: 'Sum of terms from T₅ to T₁₀' = S₁₀ − S₄.
tip.bm: 'Hasil tambah sebutan T₅ hingga T₁₀' = S₁₀ − S₄.

keyPoints.en: A GP has a constant common ratio r = T₂/T₁ = T₃/T₂ = …
keyPoints.bm: JG mempunyai nisbah sepunya malar r = T₂/T₁ = T₃/T₂ = …
Hasil tambah: Sₙ = a(rⁿ − 1)/(r − 1) (r > 1) atau a(1 − rⁿ)/(1 − r) (r < 1).

keyPoints.en: If −1 < r < 1, rⁿ → 0 as n grows, so S∞ = a/(1 − r).
keyPoints.bm: Jika −1 < r < 1, rⁿ → 0 apabila n membesar, jadi S∞ = a/(1 − r).

keyPoints.en: Applications: compound interest, population growth, bouncing balls, recurring decimals.
keyPoints.bm: Aplikasi: faedah kompaun, pertumbuhan populasi, bola melantun, perpuluhan berulang.

question.en: A ball is dropped from 10 m and bounces to 3/4 of its previous height each time. Find the total vertical distance travelled.
question.bm: Bola dijatuhkan dari 10 m dan melantun 3/4 daripada ketinggian sebelumnya setiap kali. Cari jumlah jarak menegak yang dilalui.

tip.en: In bouncing ball questions, each bounce height is travelled twice (up and down).
tip.bm: Dalam soalan bola melantun, setiap ketinggian lantunan dilalui dua kali (naik dan turun).
